words.root_logic: abs-（撇开）+ tin（tenere 握住，复合词里元音弱化）+ -ence → 长期把手收着不去碰这件事
words.origin: 拉丁语 abstinentia ← abstinens，是 abstinere（abs- 离开 + tenere 握住）的现在分词
words.native_definition: the practice of deliberately not doing or taking something one wants
words.core_concept: keeping one's hand held back over time – 把手一直收着，不是一次而是一段日子
words.core_image: 酒瓶原封摆在柜子上，一层薄灰积了半年，没人动过
examples: He has maintained total abstinence for ten years.
The doctor recommended abstinence from salt.
semantic_expansions: 戒除：不去碰某样特定的东西，像酒或烟
节制：泛指管住自己的欲，范围比戒某一物宽
collocations: abstinence from sth —— 戒除某物，介词固定用 from
total / complete abstinence —— 完全戒除，常与 maintain 连用
